question_text: Discuss processing-time and memory considerations when a live 3D display adds many more objects and higher-resolution textures.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: More objects/pixels increase rendering work and can reduce frame rate unless processing throughput increases. A GPU can perform many similar graphics operations in parallel. Larger textures and working results need more RAM; insufficient capacity may force extra transfers or reduced detail. Choose processing and memory together against the target frame rate and acceptable detail, cost and power use.

marking_points.criterion: More graphics work increases time/reduces frame rate.
